items.rationale: Covered as necessary repair labour (7.1.7(g)), for opening and reinstating the partition to access the leak. Rate per hour and total line calibrated to price priors and reference cases (e.g., case 36, 65).

Covers screws, tape, filler used to reinstate the partition, which are necessary consumables for the repair (7.1.7(c)). No evidence of improvement or excess. Reference cases (e.g., 36, 65) support inclusion.
Travel/call-out for repair attendance is covered (7.1.7(f)), and this is a standard, indemnified line per price priors and reference cases (e.g., 65, 56).
Leak detection to locate the source is covered as necessary investigation (7.1.7(e)), and is always indemnified in similar reference cases (e.g., 21, 65, 62).
Drying of the affected laundry area is necessary preparatory work (7.1.7(b)), and the area matches the measured wet zone. Reference cases (e.g., 65, 21, 36) support inclusion.
Rental of one dryer used for the affected area is covered (7.1.7(e)), but only one unit was actually used (others stood unplugged). Reference cases (e.g., 65, 21, 36) support inclusion for one unit.

items.description: Wet insulation wool from basement (Blow-Dry Bros)
items.rationale: Removal and disposal of wet insulation from the affected partition is necessary debris removal (7.1.7(a)), matching reference cases (e.g., 65, 62).

items.description: Profipress elbow 90° copper 28mm model 01 (5 pcs, Soggy Bottom Plumbing)
items.rationale: Fittings used in the repair of the affected pipe are covered as necessary material (7.1.7(c)), and the quantity matches the described bends. Price per piece from priors and reference cases (e.g., 56, 40).

items.description: Transition piece 15x19mm (3 pcs, Soggy Bottom Plumbing)
items.rationale: Transition pieces at each end and at the washing machine branch are necessary for the repair (7.1.7(c)). Reference cases (e.g., 62, 65) support inclusion; price estimated from similar fittings.

items.description: Helper hours (5 hrs, Soggy Bottom Plumbing)
items.rationale: Helper's labour for carrying/holding during the repair is covered (7.1.7(g)), with rate and total from priors and reference cases (e.g., 56, 40, 44).

items.description: Service technician hours (5.5 hrs, Soggy Bottom Plumbing)
items.rationale: Plumber's skilled labour for the pipe repair and pressure test is covered (7.1.7(g)), with rate and total from priors and reference cases (e.g., 56, 40, 44).

items.description: Vehicle costs (2 pcs, Soggy Bottom Plumbing)
items.rationale: Travel/call-out for both plumber visits is covered (7.1.7(f)), and this is a standard, indemnified line per price priors and reference cases (e.g., 65, 56).

items.description: Skilled worker hours (14 –, Grout Expectations Tiling)
items.rationale: Tiler and journeyman relaying affected floor tiles is necessary repair (7.1.7(g)), and the hours are plausible for a two-person, full-day job. Rate and total from priors and reference cases (e.g., 36).
Only adhesive and grout were needed (tiles were already on site); these are necessary consumables for the repair (7.1.7(c)). Reference cases (e.g., 36) support inclusion for such material.
Travel/call-out for the tiling crew is covered (7.1.7(f)), and this is a standard, indemnified line per price priors and reference cases (e.g., 65, 56).
